hypothesis: A 25% mixture of fixed-frame, arm-length-scaled EgoDex test trajectories can raise continuous wrist-command speed without discarding the existing persistent-operation/balance distribution.
source: data/egodex_test_wrist_commands.npz; 3243 test clips, fixed shoulder-ground frame, native 30 Hz timing, no human actions or future observations
training: one 4-GPU DDP pilot; 1024 environments per rank / 4096 total; seed 2601; 5000 new iterations
single_conceptual_change: egodex_probability=0.25; all existing rewards, physics, workspace, clutch and continuous/persistent settings retained
limitations: The EgoDex test split is used for training in this user-requested pilot, so it is not an independent evaluator. No automated held-out rollout is run.
